description: Takes the filing session's continuationHandle. Returns the packet schema a completed return packet is checked against (the packet holds no Social Security number, ITIN or PIN: the taxpayer types those on the filing page): requestPacketSchema=true returns the schema digest (packetSchemaSha256, sent with the completed packet), an outline whose larger parts are named sections, the section list and the packetStarterTemplates list; packetSchemaSection=<name> returns one section and packetStarterTemplate=<id> one complete starter packet, in which each taxpayer-specific value is the placeholder REPLACE_WITH_TAXPAYER_VALUE, refused by path until replaced, with its askTheTaxpayer messages (the questions for the taxpayer) and each preset answer listed in presets with how it is settled. Read-only: no tax facts are sent here and no return is written. The tax year is return.taxYear=2025 inside the packet, not a tool argument; any other argument is refused by name.

packetSchemaSection.description: One section of the packet schema, by a name from packetSchemaSections. Returns that section's members exactly as they sit in the full schema, where the outline shows {"x-terminalTaxSchemaSection":"<name>"}, with the section's own sha256.

packetStarterTemplate.description: One complete starter packet, by an id from packetStarterTemplates.templates, with its askTheTaxpayer messages and its presets.

requestPacketSchema.description: Returns the packet schema outline, its section list and digest, and the starter-template list; no tax facts are sent and no return is written.

name: get_packet_schema

packetSchemaOutline.description: The packet JSON Schema with each sectioned member replaced by {"x-terminalTaxSchemaSection":"<section name>"}.

packetSchemaSection.description: One section: name, covers, parentPointer (JSON Pointer of the properties object its members belong to), sha256 and members.

packetSchemaSections.description: Every schema section left out of the outline: name, what it covers, its size in characters and the sha256 of its members.

packetSchemaSha256.description: SHA-256 of the compact JSON serialization of the FULL packet schema: the outline with every section's members put back in place of its marker.

packetStarterTemplate.description: One starter template: id, shape, askTheTaxpayer, packet and presets.

packetStarterTemplates.description: How to use a starter template, the presets every template carries, and the list of templates; a template's packet comes back with packetStarterTemplate.

title: Get packet schema
